en.hubeali: Abu Ali Al Ashary, from Muhammad Bin Abdul Jabbar, from Safwan, from Ibn Muskan, from Yazeed Bin Khaleefa who said,
‘Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> disliked selling the juice with a delay (on credit, lest it turns into wine)’.
en.sarwar: 4. Abu Ali al-Ash’ariy has narrated from Muhammad ibn ‘Abd al-Jabbar from Safwan from ibn Muskan from Yazid ibn Khalifah who has said the following: “
Abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, disliked selling juice for deferred payment.”
